SQLite only. Start with WITH calendar_input AS (your SELECT exposing row_id, start_date, end_date), then append these CTEs, then SELECT from calendar_interval. Reserve the calendar_* CTE names.
Inputs: strict YYYY-MM-DD dates, years 0001..9999; NULL, invalid dates and timestamps yield NULL components and direction, preserving the row.
Output: nonnegative years, remaining months (0..11), remaining days; direction=-1 for reversed inputs, otherwise +1. Dates are ordered first: this is an absolute calendar span, not a signed SQL AGE implementation. Take the maximum whole months with the original day clamped to the target month end; divide into years/months; days are the remaining elapsed days. Rounding, fractional-year conversion and aggregation remain explicit caller choices. No DB read, UDF or SQL execution occurs in this tool.

calendar_validated AS (
  SELECT row_id,
    CASE WHEN typeof(start_date) = 'text' AND length(start_date) = 10
      AND start_date BETWEEN '0001-01-01' AND '9999-12-31'
      AND date(start_date, '+0 days') = start_date THEN start_date END AS s,
    CASE WHEN typeof(end_date) = 'text' AND length(end_date) = 10
      AND end_date BETWEEN '0001-01-01' AND '9999-12-31'
      AND date(end_date, '+0 days') = end_date THEN end_date END AS e
  FROM calendar_input
), calendar_ordered AS (
  SELECT row_id, MIN(s, e) AS lo, MAX(s, e) AS hi,
    CASE WHEN s IS NULL OR e IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN e < s THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS direction
  FROM calendar_validated
), calendar_months AS (
  SELECT *, (CAST(strftime('%Y', hi) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', lo) AS INTEGER)) * 12
    + CAST(strftime('%m', hi) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%m', lo) AS INTEGER) AS m
  FROM calendar_ordered
), calendar_complete_months AS (
  SELECT *, m - CASE WHEN date(date(lo, 'start of month', printf('+%d months', m)), printf('+%d days', MIN(CAST(strftime('%d', lo) AS INTEGER), CASE WHEN strftime('%m', date(lo, 'start of month', printf('+%d months', m))) = '12' THEN 31 ELSE CAST(strftime('%d', date(date(lo, 'start of month', printf('+%d months', m)), '+1 month', '-1 day')) AS INTEGER) END) - 1)) > hi THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS whole_months
  FROM calendar_months
), calendar_interval AS (
  SELECT row_id, direction,
    whole_months / 12 AS years, whole_months % 12 AS months,
    CAST(julianday(hi) - julianday(date(date(lo, 'start of month', printf('+%d months', whole_months)), printf('+%d days', MIN(CAST(strftime('%d', lo) AS INTEGER), CASE WHEN strftime('%m', date(lo, 'start of month', printf('+%d months', whole_months))) = '12' THEN 31 ELSE CAST(strftime('%d', date(date(lo, 'start of month', printf('+%d months', whole_months)), '+1 month', '-1 day')) AS INTEGER) END) - 1))) AS INTEGER) AS days
  FROM calendar_complete_months
)

SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    2026 - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
         - (strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday) > '10-09') AS completed_age
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.ID IN (
    SELECT l.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.GLU >= 180
      AND l."T-CHO" < 250
)
ORDER BY p.ID
LIMIT -1
